          document.documentElement.style.backgroundColor = fallbackColor;
          setThemeColor(fallbackColor);
        }

      html,

      #boot-shell {
        position: relative;
        overflow: hidden;
        display: flex;
        min-height: 100%;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        background: inherit;
        color: inherit;

        color: var(--boot-foreground);

        position: relative;
        z-index: 1;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        width: 96px;
        height: 96px;
      }

      #boot-shell-logo {
        width: 64px;
        height: 64px;
        object-fit: contain;
      }

      /* App CSS locks body and #root scrolling once main loads, so the error screen scrolls itself. */

        height: 100%;
        overflow-x: hidden;
        overflow-y: auto;
      }

      #boot-error {
        --boot-error-fg: #262626;
        --boot-error-bg: #ffffff;
        --boot-error-line: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 12%, transparent);
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: flex-start;
        align-self: flex-start;
        width: min(400px, calc(100% - 48px));
        padding: clamp(24px, 22vh, 220px) 0 24px;
        font-size: 13px;
        line-height: 20px;
      }

      html.dark #boot-error {
        --boot-error-fg: #f5f5f5;
        --boot-error-bg: #000000;
      }

      html[data-theme-selected="true"] #boot-error {
        --boot-error-fg: var(--boot-foreground);
        --boot-error-bg: var(--boot-background);
      }

      #boot-error h1 {
        margin: 0;
        font-size: 15px;
        font-weight: 600;
        line-height: 22px;
      }

      #boot-error p {
        margin: 4px 0 0;
        opacity: 0.7;
        overflow-wrap: anywhere;
        text-wrap: pretty;
      }

      #boot-error code,
      #boot-error pre {
        font-family: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
        font-size: 12px;
        overflow-wrap: anywhere;
      }

      #boot-error a {
        color: inherit;
        text-decoration-line: underline;
        text-decoration-color: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 40%, transparent);
        text-underline-offset: 3px;
      }

      #boot-error a:hover {
        text-decoration-color: currentColor;
      }

      #boot-error button {
        height: 32px;
        padding: 0 14px;
        border: 1px solid var(--boot-error-line);
        border-radius: 6px;
        background: transparent;
        color: inherit;
        font: inherit;
        font-weight: 500;
        cursor: pointer;
      }

      #boot-error button[aria-disabled="true"] {
        opacity: 0.6;
        cursor: default;
      }

      #boot-error :is(button, a, summary, pre):focus-visible {
        outline: 2px solid var(--boot-error-fg);
        outline-offset: 2px;
      }

      #boot-error-actions {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        gap: 8px;
        margin-top: 16px;
      }

      #boot-error #boot-error-reload {
        border-color: var(--boot-error-fg);
        background: var(--boot-error-fg);
        color: var(--boot-error-bg);
      }

      #boot-error-reload:hover {
        opacity: 0.9;
      }

      #boot-error #boot-error-update-note {
        margin-top: 8px;
        font-size: 12px;
        line-height: 18px;
      }

      #boot-error details {
        width: 100%;
        margin-top: 32px;
      }

      #boot-error summary {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 8px;
        border-radius: 4px;
        list-style: none;
        opacity: 0.7;
        cursor: pointer;
      }

      #boot-error summary::-webkit-details-marker {
        display: none;
      }

      #boot-error summary::before {
        content: "";
        width: 5px;
        height: 5px;
        border-right: 1.5px solid currentColor;
        border-bottom: 1.5px solid currentColor;
        transform: rotate(-45deg);
      }

      #boot-error details[open] summary::before {
        transform: rotate(45deg);
      }

      #boot-error summary:hover,
      #boot-error details[open] summary {
        opacity: 1;
      }

      #boot-error details > :not(summary) {
        display: grid;
        gap: 8px;
        margin-top: 20px;
      }

      #boot-error details > a {
        display: block;
        width: fit-content;
      }

      #boot-error details p {
        margin: 0;
        font-size: 12px;
        line-height: 18px;
      }

      #boot-error-command {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 8px;
        padding: 4px 4px 4px 10px;
        border: 1px solid var(--boot-error-line);
        border-radius: 6px;
      }

      #boot-error-command code {
        flex: 1;
        min-width: 0;
        opacity: 0.8;
      }

      #boot-error .boot-error-icon {
        display: grid;
        flex: none;
        place-items: center;
        min-width: 24px;
        height: 24px;
        padding: 0 4px;
        border: 0;
        border-radius: 4px;
        font-size: 12px;
        font-weight: 400;

      }

      #boot-error .boot-error-icon:hover {
        opacity: 1;
        background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 8%, transparent);
      }

      #boot-error-details {
        max-height: 200px;

        gap: 16px;
      }

      #boot-error-report button {
        height: 28px;
        padding: 0 10px;
      }

      .boot-error-sr {
        position: absolute;
        width: 1px;
        height: 1px;
        overflow: hidden;
        clip-path: inset(50%);
        white-space: nowrap;
      }

              accent: "oklch(0.536684 0.120219 247.01)",

              background: "oklch(0.976527 0.002685 60.725)",
              foreground: "oklch(0.222003 0.03479 328.979)",
              accent: "oklch(0.552831 0.129438 44.656)",
              chrome: "oklch(0.976527 0.002685 60.725)",
            },
            dark: {

              foreground: "oklch(0.990339 0.008411 325.64)",

              chrome: "oklch(0.245899 0.019144 42.044)",

              background: "oklch(0.976531 0.003855 303.226)",
              foreground: "oklch(0.222003 0.03479 328.979)",
              accent: "oklch(0.525348 0.15373 294.176)",
              chrome: "oklch(0.976531 0.003855 303.226)",

            Object.keys(palettes),
          ]),
        );
        const RESERVED_THEME_IDS = [
          "system",
          "light",
          "dark",
          "t3-chat",
          "grove",
          "ocean",
          "ember",
          "iris",
          "t3-chat-dark",
          "t3-grove",
          "t3-ocean",
          "t3-ember",
          "t3-iris",

        // contextual colors out: they cannot be resolved from stored data.

            /^(?:currentcolor|inherit|initial|revert|revert-layer|unset)$/i.test(color) ||

            /\bfrom\b|(?:var|env|attr|calc|min|max|clamp)\(/i.test(color)

            return false;
          }

            /^#(?:[0-9a-f]{3}|[0-9a-f]{4}|[0-9a-f]{6}|[0-9a-f]{8})$/i.test(color) ||

            /^(?:rgba?|hsla?|hwb|lab|lch|oklab|oklch|color)\(/i.test(color);

        };

          typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);

          typeof value === "string" && /^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,47})$/.test(value);
        const isThemeLabel = (value) =>
          typeof value === "string" && value.trim().length > 0 && value.trim().length <= 48;
        const isThemePreferenceMode = (value) =>
          value === "light" || value === "dark" || value === "system";
        const isThemeAppearance = (value) => value === "light" || value === "dark";
        const isStoredCustomTheme = (value) => {
          if (
            !isRecord(value) ||
            !isThemeId(value.id) ||
            RESERVED_THEME_IDS.includes(value.id) ||
            !isThemeLabel(value.label) ||
            !isThemeAppearance(value.appearance) ||
            !isRecord(value.colors)
          ) {
            return false;
          }
          if (value.variants === undefined) return true;
          if (!isRecord(value.variants)) return false;
          return Object.entries(value.variants).every(
            ([appearance, colors]) =>
              isThemeAppearance(appearance) &&
              (appearance === value.appearance || isRecord(colors)),

          if (RESERVED_THEME_IDS.includes(themeId)) return null;
          try {
            const parsed = JSON.parse(
              window.localStorage.getItem(CUSTOM_THEMES_STORAGE_KEY) ?? "null",

            "t3-chat-dark": "t3-chat",
            "t3-grove": "grove",
            "t3-ocean": "ocean",
            "t3-ember": "ember",
            "t3-iris": "iris",
          };
          const isLegacyT3ChatDark = storedTheme === "t3-chat-dark";
          const themeId =
            storedTheme === null ? "" : (LEGACY_THEME_IDS[storedTheme] ?? storedTheme);
          const legacyMode = isLegacyT3ChatDark ? "dark" : null;
          const builtInModes = BUILT_IN_THEME_MODES[themeId] ?? null;
          const customTheme = builtInModes ? null : findCustomTheme(themeId);

            builtInModes ??

            storedTheme === "light" ||

                halfCustomTheme = halfCustom;

            ? null
            : appearanceMode === "system"
              ? themeModes.includes(systemMode)
                ? systemMode
                : baseAppearance
              : themeModes.includes(appearanceMode)
                ? appearanceMode
                : baseAppearance;

            halfThemeId !== null
              ? wantedMode === "dark"
              : isThemed
                ? themeMode === "dark"
                : appearanceMode === "system"
                  ? prefersDark
                  : appearanceMode === "dark";
          const effectiveIsThemed = halfThemeId !== null || isThemed;
          const effectiveThemeId = halfThemeId ?? themeId;
          const effectiveCustomTheme = halfThemeId !== null ? halfCustomTheme : customTheme;
          const effectiveThemeMode = halfThemeId !== null ? wantedMode : themeMode;
          const customColors =
            effectiveIsThemed && effectiveCustomTheme
              ? effectiveThemeMode === effectiveCustomTheme.appearance
                ? effectiveCustomTheme.colors
                : (effectiveCustomTheme.variants?.[effectiveThemeMode] ??
                  effectiveCustomTheme.colors)
              : null;
          const customDefaults =
            effectiveCustomTheme && effectiveThemeMode
              ? DEFAULT_THEME_PALETTES[effectiveThemeMode]
              : null;

          // per role rather than dropping the theme.
          const builtInSplash =
            effectiveIsThemed && !effectiveCustomTheme && effectiveThemeMode
              ? (BUILT_IN_THEME_PALETTES[effectiveThemeId]?.[effectiveThemeMode] ?? null)
              : null;
          const fallbackSplash = isDark ? SPLASH_COLORS.dark : SPLASH_COLORS.light;
          const customSplash = customColors
            ? {
                background: isThemeColor(customColors.canvas)
                  ? customColors.canvas
                  : (customDefaults?.background ?? fallbackSplash.background),
                foreground: isThemeColor(customColors.text)
                  ? customColors.text
                  : (customDefaults?.foreground ?? fallbackSplash.foreground),
                accent: isThemeColor(customColors.accent)
                  ? customColors.accent
                  : (customDefaults?.accent ?? fallbackSplash.accent),
              }
            : null;

              ? effectiveCustomTheme.id

            delete document.documentElement.dataset.themeId;
          }

          // (deleting the base leaves the mix pointing at a real theme).
          const hasSelection = halfThemeId !== null || (isKnownTheme && storedTheme !== null);

            document.documentElement.dataset.themeSelected = "true";
          } else {
            delete document.documentElement.dataset.themeSelected;
          }
          document.documentElement.classList.toggle("dark", isDark);
          const chromeColor = customColors
            ? isThemeColor(customColors.chrome)
              ? customColors.chrome
              : (customDefaults?.chrome ?? fallbackSplash.background)
            : builtInSplash
              ? builtInSplash.chrome
              : isDark
                ? DARK_BACKGROUND
                : LIGHT_BACKGROUND;
          document.documentElement.style.backgroundColor = chromeColor;
          if (hasSelection) {
            const splashColors = customSplash ?? builtInSplash ?? fallbackSplash;
            for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(splashColors)) {
              document.documentElement.style.setProperty(`--boot-${name}`, value);
            }
          }
          setThemeColor(chromeColor);
        } catch {
          let prefersDark = true;
          try {
            prefersDark = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches;
          } catch {}
          delete document.documentElement.dataset.themeId;
          delete document.documentElement.dataset.themeSelected;
          document.documentElement.classList.toggle("dark", prefersDark);
          const fallbackColor = prefersDark ? DARK_BACKGROUND : LIGHT_BACKGROUND;
          document.documentElement.style.backgroundColor = fallbackColor;
          setThemeColor(fallbackColor);
        }
